# Reiki

Security proxy for agent and LLM traffic: isolates keys, filters what leaves, keeps access reliable.

- [README](README.md): install, ten-minute proof, configuration, operations, limits and security model.
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): build, test, lint, docs-check commands, repo map and conventions.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): private reporting, supported versions and response targets.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release notes by version and section.

## Start

- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): the reading order and every page.
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): proof-first setup with expected output and a negative test.
- [Install](docs/install.md): tuishou one-liner status, manual install and verification.
- [Overview](docs/overview.md): the model, listeners and request path.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): request flow, key states and source map.
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): CLI and status vocabulary.
- [Command line](docs/cli.md): every subcommand, flag and exit code.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every table, field, default and validation rule.

## Keys, traffic and providers

- [Keys and streams](docs/keys.md): key files, hashes, chains and dynamic stream credentials.
- [Providers](docs/providers.md): upstream mapping, provider status and test coverage.
- [OpenCode](docs/opencode.md): base URL, token, proof check and bypasses.
- [Claude Code](docs/claude-code.md): base URL, token, proof check and bypasses.
- [Failover](docs/failover.md): chains and key states.
- [Classification](docs/classification.md): response rules, cooldowns and client errors.
- [Shaping](docs/shaping.md): outbound limits and stream admission.
- [Dynamic streams](docs/dynamic-streams.md): operating the opt-in stream admin API, audit and backups.

## Security and data

- [Security](docs/security.md): assets, trust boundaries and fail-closed behavior.
- [Limits and non-goals](docs/limits.md): what Reiki does not protect against.
- [Redaction reference](docs/redaction.md): exact scrubbed forms.
- [Plugins](docs/plugins.md): build-time plugin set and order.
- [Plugin authoring](docs/plugin-authoring.md): hooks, tests and registration.
- [Wasm plugins](docs/wasm-plugins.md): opt-in runtime plugin host and capabilities.
- [Placeholders](docs/placeholders.md), [PHI](docs/phi.md), [Finance](docs/finance.md), [Controlled](docs/controlled.md), [Tool policy](docs/toolpolicy.md), [Cost](docs/cost.md): egress controls and opt-in accounting.
- [Tunnel](docs/tunnel.md): opaque CONNECT and TLS interception.
- [Request log](docs/requestlog.md): summary records and optional masked capture.
